scripts.deploy: npm run build -w web && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: npm run build -w web && wrangler dev

API_KEY.description: Login password for Pawmc. You will enter it in the web app to log in.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional: your [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/keys) API key. Leave empty to use the free Workers AI.

AI_MODEL_OPENROUTER.description: OpenRouter model used for chats when a key is set. Any [model slug](https://openrouter.ai/models) works.
